sample_reviews.author: Paul T
sample_reviews.text: KB sorted our boiler out the same day we called. Fast, tidy and very reasonably priced. Would highly recommend to anyone in Liverpool.

sample_reviews.author: Sarah M
sample_reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Turned up on time, explained everything clearly and left no mess. Will definitely be using KB Plumbing again.

sample_reviews.author: Dave R
sample_reviews.text: Had a leak under the sink that needed fixing urgently. KB came out quickly and had it sorted within the hour. Great local tradesman, very trustworthy.

brand.usp: KB Plumbing & Heating offers fast, reliable plumbing and heating solutions across Liverpool, with honest pricing and a Gas Safe registered engineer you can trust.
brand.about_paragraph: I'm KB, a fully qualified and Gas Safe registered plumber and heating engineer based right here in Liverpool L4. I've built my reputation on turning up when I say I will, doing the job properly, and charging a fair price. Whether it's a leaking pipe, a new boiler, or a full central heating installation, I'm here to help.
